channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due in 2 days] User.ReadBasic.All stops returning app role assignments and licence details — a security fix, live this month
[Due in 2 days] Security Administrator gains identity response actions against non-privileged users
[Due in 2 days] Entra Connect Sync minimum version 2.5.79.0
[New] Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings
[New] Actively exploited Windows Update Stack elevation of privilege stays under revision, with no CVSS score published
[New] Critical Windows ALPC elevation of privilege, marked exploited, has its exploit-maturity vector corrected
[New] The Entra Cloud Sync provisioning-into-Active-Directory documentation set goes to general documentation
[New] Cloud Sync configuration article drops the note naming the sync service account and its MFA trap
[New] Entra Connect Sync 2.6.91.0 ships security fixes; Microsoft says upgrade as soon as possible
[New] Entra Connect Sync 2.6.92.0 is a hotfix for a Pass-through Authentication agent registration failure in 2.6.91.0
[New] Entra Kerberos hybrid join drops EnableKerbHaadj.exe for a Windows Server 2025 build floor
[New] Microsoft corrected PIM for Groups: eligible members and owners are credential-protected too, and changing those credentials needs Privileged Authentication Administrator
[New] Cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips and calendar sharing move onto Cross-Tenant Access policy
[New] September 2026 Exchange Server security updates are released — on 24 September, not on 8 September as this brief said
[New] AgentIdentity.ReadWrite.All can now PATCH any service principal, not only an agent identity
[New] A new Entra authentication event appears in Graph: onAccountTakeoverProtectionStart
[New] Graph finally lets an audit-log query say it was truncated
[New] Four Defender automation permissions enter Microsoft's deployment map: playbook executions and integrations
[New] Microsoft's Graph deployment map gained five hidden permissions today, four for Teams call events and one that creates a Windows Hello authentication method
[New] Eight Graph permissions became grantable in the service principal: app certificate trust configuration, cross-tenant content migration and workbooks
[New] Ten new Graph permissions become grantable in the service principal — six of them a brand-new Purview ABAC surface, none documented
[New] ThreatHunting.Read.All quietly grows from running queries to reading everyone's saved hunting queries
[New] Microsoft re-released its September, August and July advisory documents on 25 September, after most teams had finished triaging them
[New] Storm-3168 drives cloud intrusions with agentic tooling on compromised service principals
[New] September update makes Windows 11 honour Machine Identity Isolation; devices not on a Windows Server 2025 domain functional level lose domain trust
[New] The 14 September out-of-band update fixes RDP instability and introduces an AD trust break on Credential Guard machines
[Due in 2 days] System-preferred authentication applies to first-factor sign-in
[Due in 2 days] Conditional Access custom controls become read-only
[Due in 3 days] Identity Protection legacy risk policies retire
[Due in 7 days] SSPR requires registered authentication methods
[New] [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
[New] Conditional Access now applies to Outlook attachment download, preview and upload
[New] Copilot Studio agents move to Entra Agent ID, and their connector permissions become visible to Conditional Access
[New] The cloud sync group provisioning tutorial is retired and redirected, and this brief cited it fourteen times
[New] App Gallery self-service onboarding will not validate an application on identity platform v1 endpoints
[New] Custom call-outs for attribute mappings left preview in Microsoft's own article title
[New] Two hidden Mail-Advanced permissions now name Office 365 Exchange Online as their resource application
[New] The deployment map gains UserCertificateIds.ReadWrite.All on the legacy Azure AD Graph resource and moves seven ResourcePolicy scopes off Microsoft Graph
[New] Three already-consented Graph permissions reach three new endpoints, with no fresh consent prompt
[New] Critical Secure Kernel Mode elevation of privilege ships out of band on 14 September
[New] Copilot Studio agents can call MCP-compliant tools inside workflows
[New] Out-of-band Windows update fixes RDS hangs from the September rollup and patches CVE-2026-62721
[New] A Microsoft-managed "Agent 365 CLI" enterprise application appears in Entra without an admin creating it
[New] Cloud Sync provisioning agent 1.1.2505.0 drops the Domain Admin requirement with a gMSA and removes Repair-AADCloudSyncToolsAccount
[New] Cloud Sync begins provisioning cloud users and groups into on-premises Active Directory
[New] Microsoft's DCU disrupts EvilTokens, a phishing-as-a-service platform built around device code flow and token theft
[New] NetworkAccess.Read.All and NetworkAccess.ReadWrite.All silently reach a new Global Secure Access secure-enterprise-browser endpoint
[New] Managed Home Screen can now require authentication before a protected app activity, closing a shared-device bypass
[New] App Governance drops Cloud Application Administrator role support
[Due in 2 days] Microsoft 365 Copilot: Retirement of the Sites control in Researcher
[Due in 2 days] Final reminder: Microsoft Project Online retires on September 30, 2026

item.title: [Due in 2 days] Container Log V1 and Service Bus control-plane APIs retire
[Due in 2 days] Get AlertSummary and smart groups APIs retire

[New] B2B passkey rollout: guests enabled for SMS or voice will be auto-enabled for all passkey types
[New] Advanced hunting gains a MessageContents table carrying Teams message snippets, permission-gated
[New] Web based enrollment becomes the default for iOS and iPadOS, and it needs the SSO extension and just-in-time registration to work
[New] Purview DLP extends to Microsoft Cowork, applying existing Copilot policies to a second AI surface automatically
[New] Security Copilot agents arrive in Defender, Entra, Intune and Purview with the E5/E7 entitlement, no purchase and no opt-in
[New] Agent 365 agents can be connected into declarative agents, with an approval surface in the admin centre
[New] Express face enrollment builds a Teams face profile from the meeting camera after opt-in
[New] Legacy Teams retention policies stop implicitly covering Copilot interactions
[New] Integrated Security Operations Center reaches preview for Defender customers who have no Sentinel workspace
[New] App Gallery onboarding goes self-service in public preview
[New] The Entra health alerts how-to moved from howto-use to howto-investigate
[New] Global Secure Access health articles now name the licences, roles and Graph permissions each signal needs
[New] The Risky IP report is retired
[New] Cross-tenant message recall arrives in Exchange Online
[New] Access reviews over customer-supplied entitlement data reach v1.0, with a permission field on every decision item
[New] Entitlement management's accessOrchestratorRequests endpoints are replaced by dynamicAccessRequests and dynamicAccessSessions
[New] Microsoft withdrew the two narrow guest lifecycle scopes, leaving only the tenant-wide pair
[New] Two access-package methods silently return nothing for SharePoint when called with application permissions
[New] Intune raises the minimum supported iOS and iPadOS to 18, and devices below it lose standard management
[New] A new endpoint security setting audits or blocks unsafe AI agent activity on Windows
[New] Four SQL Server remote code execution CVEs are rescored to require no privileges at all
[New] Purview enforces DLP at the network layer through Global Secure Access
[New] Multi-account support for Sentinel codeless connectors enters public preview
[New] Sentinel data lake stops being a separate onboarding: one onboarding, lake tier switched on per table
[New] Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention-Upgraded inline protection for Microsoft Entra-managed apps in Edge for Business
[New] Users are offered a passkey or another passwordless method as their first MFA registration, phased from October
[New] Managed identity for host pools reaches GA, and a future update will require it
[New] The AD FS Risky IP report is deprecated in favour of the Risky IP workbook
[New] Access drift reporting arrives in preview for groups and enterprise applications
[New] Global Secure Access allows up to ten custom Private Access forwarding profiles, and priority decides which one applies
[New] Windows devices re-evaluate compliance on a security state change instead of waiting for check-in
[New] The v3.x sensor covers AD CS, AD FS and Entra Connect, by manual activation only
[New] The v3.x sensor can be activated on a domain controller without onboarding Defender for Endpoint first
[Due in 2 days] Viva Engage community administration starts requiring an Entra role

[New] Microsoft Purview: DSPM-Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
[New] Outlook and Word remote code execution has its title and CVSS score changed twice inside the window

[New] Purview audit adds two RBAC permission-check operations: CheckUsersInRoles and CheckUserInRolesWithScopes

[New] EmailPostDeliveryEvents gains an ApproverUpn column naming who approved a remediation

[New] Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
[New] Edge autolaunch on Windows startup becomes an opt-in a policy can pin three ways
[New] Access package resource roles gain a documented search box for SharePoint sites with many roles
[New] Registration campaign in the Enabled state now prompts Authenticator setup after any MFA method, not only SMS or voice
[New] Listing access package catalog resources returns SharePoint sites only under delegated permissions
[New] The endpoint map catches up with the 24 September permissions sync: three permissions, three more endpoints
[New] IdentityRiskEvent.ReadWrite.All gains a delegated scheme and an agent-notification endpoint
[New] Policies and apps can be rolled out in rings with approval gates through deployment plans
[New] The Message Center index is now read whole — 2,497 rows in one request — and its date column turns out to be Last updated, not Published
[New] Mac security builds become available for roughly eighty Office CVEs already patched on Windows
[New] Microsoft publishes Storm-2570's repeated tradecraft across deployments, not just its ransomware payload

[New] AgentIdentityBlueprintPrincipal.ReadWrite.All reaches one more endpoint
